title: Baby names explorer
meta_description: Use our interactive tool to compare changes in the top 100 baby names for boys and girls since 1904.

body.text: How popular is your name? Has it recently entered the top 100, dropped out and made a comeback, or disappeared from the list completely?
Our interactive tool shows the top 100 names in 2025 for baby boys and girls in England and Wales each year since 1996.
